extensions.description: This agent's interface is MCP over stdio, not A2A. The card is a capability manifest and discovery record, not an A2A endpoint declaration; no A2A endpoint exists for this agent. The params carry the invocation facts a client config generator needs to wire this server from the card alone.

description: Research-feed MCP server: literature-watch findings, watchlist, and revenue-candidate drafts. It holds a curated findings store and watchlist on plain files under a data root; submissions are filed to a scan inbox and never write the curated store, and revenue drafts are generated for lupin without ever writing lupin's files. This card is a discovery record and capability manifest for catalogues, registries, and client-config generators; Phaedrus does not expose an A2A endpoint.
name: Phaedrus

skills.description: Curated literature-watch findings: list findings, fetch one by id, and read feed counts by system and kind with parse health (feed_summary, finding_list, finding_get).
skills.name: Findings store

skills.description: The research watchlist: per-system venues and search terms that drive the literature watch (watchlist_list).
skills.name: Watchlist

skills.description: File a candidate (finding, roadmap item, or test proposal) into the scan inbox; intake never writes the curated store (research_submit).
skills.name: Research intake

skills.description: Read lupin's capability registry as planning vocabulary and draft (never file) a lupin opportunity_submit payload for a revenue-shaped finding (capability_context, revenue_candidate_draft).
skills.name: Revenue candidate drafts
